notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
